title: American Coastal Insurance Corporation Schedules Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results and Conference Call
summary: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla., Feb. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - American Coastal Insurance Corporation (Nasdaq Ticker: ACIC) (“the Company”, “American Coastal” or “ACIC”), the insurance holding company of American Coastal Insurance Company (“AmCoastal”), announced today that it expects to release its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025, on Thursday, February 19, 2026, after the close of the market, and will conduct its quarterly conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET. The conference call will include live remarks followed by a question and answer (QA) session. Interested parties are invited to participate in the conference call and should dial-in 10 minutes before the conference call is scheduled to begin.
